distinguishing_features: A physical metal-to-metal lip seal replaces the elastomeric O-ring as the sealing element.
A high-CTE metallic lip and low-CTE body sleeve are arranged so thermal cycling increases seal-face interference/contact pressure.
The material pair is selected to produce a calculated contact pressure above the hydraulic working pressure.
Validation is by leak-rate reduction under combined pressure and thermal cycling rather than by condition monitoring.
